'''Zane''' (Japanese: '''ヒビキ''' ''Hibiki'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP169|Beauty and the Breeder]]''.

Zane had been friends with [[Suzie]] since they were in nursery school. They both shared dreams of becoming famous {{tc|Pokémon Breeder}}s. Like Suzie, his first Pokémon was a {{p|Vulpix}}, who he later [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Ninetales}}. Unlike his close friend, however, Zane believed that a Pokémon's true beauty came from its physical appearance and not from its inner character. Eager to prove his point, he entered the [[Pokémon Beauty Contest]], pitting his Ninetales against Suzie and [[Brock's Vulpix|her Vulpix]].

During the competition, he realized that Suzie and {{an|Brock}}'s views on [[Pokémon breeding]] were just as valid as his, and asked Suzie if she wanted to start a Pokémon beauty salon with him. After consulting with Brock, Suzie eventually accepted his offer.

Though he only appeared in one episode, Zane is notable for finally ending Brock's infatuation with Suzie. While the pair fought over Suzie's affection, Brock later realized that Zane was a better match for her than he was and eventually decided to support their relationship. Zane also grew to like Brock, recognizing him as a top-class Pokémon Breeder.
